text:
Situation: Ropivacaine hydrochloride has been on the FDA shortage list since 2018-03-23 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 9 days of 2 mg/mL, 20 mL vials. Corvale General holds 15 days and can spare 7 vials while keeping two weeks. Corvale Lakeside holds 19.1 days. Other strengths at both campuses range from 8.2 to 28.3 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2018-03-23 with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC listed. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC received an OAI classification letter dated 2024-04-30 (2230 days after posting) and a second OAI classification letter dated 2024-05-22 (2252 days after posting). The Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC plant (FEI 1450022) is named on the product label as a registered plant for manufacture and analysis.

Our position: Internal transfer is the fastest way to protect Corvale East without new procurement risk. Alternative manufacturers are not on the FDA shortage list today and their labels name no plant we could verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 7 vials of 2 mg/mL, 20 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Monitor daily usage at both campuses and update days-on-hand — approved by pharmacy operations manager.
3. Reassess alternative suppliers if transfer does not stabilize supply — approved by buyer and pharmacy director.

Not recommended: Emergency purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc., Civica, Inc., or Gland Pharma Limited at this time.
